result:
I fixed the regression in `anthrouter/http_util.py`. The requests-remaining header name was misspelled as `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`, so the value was never read from upstream responses. It's now `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`.

The two tests that failed were `test_status_reports_the_last_rate_limit_window` and `test_successful_request_records_usage_and_the_rate_limit_window`. They now pass. I ran only the 58 tests matching "rate", "limit" or "window", which all pass. I didn't re-run the full suite, so I haven't checked it for other failures.
